verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Buzz as a chat/collaboration platform with channels, canvases, CLI, and agent integration, but there is no mention of a developer-facing SDK or API for building interactive UI elements like modals, buttons, or structured message layouts inside chat — this is a distinct app-platform capability (like Slack's Block Kit) that is not documented anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: any API/SDK for interactive components, modal/button primitives, message-layout builder documentation.
